title: Notifications — know when someone follows you, answers you, appreciates you, or a teacher you follow posts

tasks.title: Notifications, unread badge and the activity page

acs.text: WHEN a viewer follows a profile THE SYSTEM SHALL notify that profile's owner (the person, or each administrator of an institution) with kind `follow`; WHEN a viewer replies to a post or reacts to it THE SYSTEM SHALL notify the post's author with kind `reply` or `reaction`; WHEN an institution or person posts THE SYSTEM SHALL notify that profile's followers with kind `post`. Nobody is notified about their own action, and removing a reaction or a follow does not notify.
scenarios: AC-001 who is notified of what

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `GET /api/v1/notifications` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with `{notifications, unread}`: the viewer's latest 50 notifications, newest first, each with its id, kind, actor (profile id and name), the post it is about (id and the start of its body) when there is one, its time and whether it is read, and `unread` the number not yet read; WHEN the viewer calls `POST /api/v1/notifications/read` THE SYSTEM SHALL mark all of them read and answer 200 with `unread: 0`.

WHEN a signed-in viewer is anywhere in social THE SYSTEM SHALL show an "Activity" link in social's navigation with the unread count as a badge when it is above zero (its accessible name includes the number), read again every 60 seconds.
scenarios: AC-003 the unread badge in social's navigation

acs.text: WHEN a viewer opens `/social/notifications` THE SYSTEM SHALL list their notifications as sentences in the interface language ("Rabbi Cohen followed you", "Dina replied to your post", "Beit Midrash posted"), unread ones marked with a dot and bold text, each linking straight to the post or profile it is about, an empty state when there are none, and mark them all read once the page is shown, setting the badge to zero.
